label: Save Properties
description: Writes plain text properties from the payload onto the target. Which properties may be written, and which must arrive with a value, are this task's own configuration rather than the caller's choice.

editable.label: Editable properties
editable.description: The payload entries a caller may write. An entry not listed here is ignored rather than refused.

required.label: Required properties
required.description: The subset of the editable properties that must arrive with a value; refused when blank.
